title: Scheduled Virtual Care Visits: Booking Window and Patient Reschedules
content:
A scheduled Virtual Care visit is booked at least the visit type's minimum booking lead ahead and no more than its booking horizon ahead, and may be moved by the patient up to the visit type's reschedule allowance while the notice for a timely cancellation still holds.

## Rule

1. **Booking window.** A scheduled virtual visit is booked at least the visit type's minimum booking lead ahead and no more than its booking horizon ahead. Scheduling gives the requested visit its date, its start time in clinic local time and its clinician, named exactly as listed in the provider directory, and moves it from requested to scheduled.
2. **Patient reschedules.** The visit may be moved by the patient up to the visit type's reschedule allowance while the notice for a timely cancellation still holds, that is, while a patient cancellation made at that moment would still be timely for the visit type.
3. **Status.** A virtual visit is rescheduled only while its status is scheduled. The status is read from the system's record of that visit before it is moved.
4. **What a move records.** A move records the new date and new start time, and the visit's reschedule count rises by one.
5. **Reminders and connection test.** Reminders go out the visit type's reminder hours before the start, and the connection test link goes out the visit type's connection-test hours before the start, where those are above 0.
6. **Visit types never scheduled.** E-visits and on-demand visits are never scheduled.

## Desk questions answered

**A visit with a hypothetical reschedule allowance of 2 has already been moved twice by the patient. May the patient move it again?** No. Its reschedule count has reached the allowance.

**May a visit whose status is in progress, completed, cancelled or no-show be rescheduled?** No. A virtual visit is rescheduled only while its status is scheduled.

**Can a Portal E-Visit or an On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care request be given a date and time?** No. E-visits and on-demand visits are never scheduled.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

| Hypothetical figure | Situation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Minimum booking lead 60 minutes | Booked at 9:00 for a 10:00 start (60 minutes ahead) | Meets the lead |
| Minimum booking lead 60 minutes | Booked at 9:30 for a 10:00 start (30 minutes ahead) | Does not meet the lead |
| Booking horizon 30 days | Booked on 1 June for 1 July (30 days ahead) | Within the horizon |
| Booking horizon 30 days | Booked on 1 June for 2 July (31 days ahead) | Beyond the horizon |
| Cancellation notice 24 hours | Visit Thursday 16:00; patient asks to move it Wednesday 15:00 (25 full hours before) | Notice still holds; the move is open to the patient |
| Cancellation notice 24 hours | Visit Thursday 16:00; patient asks to move it Wednesday 17:00 (23 full hours before) | Notice no longer holds; the move is not open to the patient under this rule |
